title: core.command.v1 VerifyCustomerFactors payload
description: Self-service PIN reset (spec 18.7, ticket 70): mw-auth asks the core whether the KYC factors the customer typed (last 4 NID digits, date of birth) match the wallet's KYC record. Sent by mw-auth (proposed to the owner mw-orchestrator in ticket 70) on core.wallet.command.v1, txnId a fresh UUIDv7, commandId pin-reset:<resetId>, key txnId. The factors never travel in clear: each is a keyed hash made by mw-crypto under TOKENISE_NID over '<walletId>:<factor>' (the date as YYYY-MM-DD), so it is bound to the wallet. The core answers CustomerFactorsVerified, or CustomerFactorsRejected (reasonCode FACTORS_MISMATCH, WALLET_NOT_FOUND, WALLET_NOT_ACTIVE). Carries no PIN.

subject.description: The wallet whose PIN is reset: its id (the MSISDN for app wallets).

tokenKid.description: The TOKENISE_NID key version (<keyId>.v<n>) both hashes were made with.
